lessons.correction: Continue strengthening ground, maintain economy, production, tech, and expansion.
lessons.mistake: Investing in unnecessary technology that delays army production.
lessons.recheck: Recheck if opponent techs up or shows air presence.
lessons.title: Avoid Premature Tech
lessons.when: Early-midgame, both sides ground, heavy economy, moderate production, light tech. Zergling and Queen cues visible.
lessons.why: Maintaining a balanced ground macro approach keeps you competitive while allowing adaptation to opponent's tech or army choices.

lessons.correction: Increase defense, economy, continue production and tech, strengthen ground.
lessons.mistake: Staying purely ground when opponent has a significant air force.
lessons.recheck: Recheck if opponent commits to air or ground.
lessons.title: Don't Ignore Air Threat
lessons.when: Midgame, opponent ground with heavy air presence, heavy economy, heavy production, moderate tech. Zergling, Mutalisk, Queen, Overseer cues.
lessons.why: With opponent having air presence, you need to bolster defenses and possibly tech to anti-air while maintaining economy.

lessons.correction: Increase air, economy, continue tech, maintain production, strengthen air.
lessons.mistake: Neglecting ground defense while teching to air.
lessons.recheck: Recheck if opponent techs anti-air or shows heavy ground pressure.
lessons.title: Don't Neglect Ground Defense
lessons.when: Midgame, opponent ground with light air, heavy economy, heavy production, heavy tech. Zergling, Roach, Queen cues.
lessons.why: If you have air presence and opponent is ground-heavy, transitioning to air can give you a strategic advantage.
